name: United Kingdom
applies: England, Scotland and Wales (TSRGD). Northern Ireland uses a parallel TSRNI set.
source_of_truth: countries/uk/*.json plus tsrgd2016_index.json. Extract is the only JSON writer.

licence.diagrams: Crown copyright. TSRGD 2016 diagrams: derived under Open Government Licence v3.0. Traffic Signs Manual: see LICENCE.md (non-commercial notice, not OGL). Faces are redrawn identification silhouettes; hex colours approximate BS EN 12899-1 classes.
licence.typeface: The Transport typeface is not shipped. Legends are Schedule 17 stand-in strokes. Seven-bar numerals are Part 5 VMS on MS4 only.
